claim: a polynomial map of 3-dimensional space with Jacobian determinant identically -2 that sends three different points to one point, refuting the Jacobian conjecture in dimension 3 and every dimension above it; the two-dimensional case is still open

source.author: Levent Alpöge, crediting Akhil Mathew and Claude Fable 5
source.note: Map and points transcribed verbatim from the Isabelle AFP entry by Freitas Ramos, Hulak and de Queiroz (lemmas eval_alpoge_map and collision_point_*), which encodes Alpöge's announced map, and cross-checked term for term against the Lean files of deancureton/jacobian and DrAlexHarrison/jacobian-anatomy (docs/sources/jacobian.md). The X post itself was not read here: automated fetching was blocked.
